text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali on Monday chaired a cabinet meeting on upgrading firms to enable them to face open-door policy. President recommended greater support to exports.
- President Ben Ali signed a law establishing the Youth's High Council.
- Foreign Affairs Minister Abderrahim Zouari received his Lebanese counterpart Faris Bouez. They discussed bilateral relations and the Middle East peace process.
- Tunisia reiterates its commitment to a just and comprehensive peace in the Middle East.
- Prime Minister Hamed Karoui received visiting speaker of Spain's Senate Juan Ignacio Barrero Valverde. Talks were on ways to reinforce bilateral cooperation between the two countries.
- President Ben Ali recommends helping small and medium-size entreprises in their efforts to modernise and adapt to increasing international competition.
- Publishers from Arab and African countries met in Tunis this week and set up an Arab-African Newspapers Confederation.
- Tunisia's consumption of industrial glass is less than 15,000 tonnes each year.
